lines.zh: 一摆尾，我已经游出十几格。
lines.en: One flick of my tail and I am a dozen blocks away.

lines.zh: 远洋没有尽头，我也不觉得累。
lines.en: The open ocean has no end, and I am not tired.

lines.zh: 我们四五条一排，顺着暖流走。
lines.en: Four or five of us abreast, riding the warm current.

lines.zh: 速度和耐力，我两样都有。
lines.en: Speed and stamina — I have both.

lines.zh: 追鱼群的时候，我从不歇。
lines.en: Chasing a school, I never stop.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面跑，浪花追不上。
lines.en: I race along the surface, and the spray falls behind.

lines.zh: 这一路的海水，我都认得。
lines.en: I know the water along this whole route.

lines.zh: 有鱼群的味道，我加速了。
lines.en: I smell a school, so I speed up.

lines.zh: 让开一点，我的尾已经摆开了。
lines.en: Give me room; my tail is already swinging.

lines.zh: 跟着同伴，一条都不会掉队。
lines.en: Falling in with my school, none of us drops behind.

lines.zh: 从这片海到那片，只要一天。
lines.en: From this sea to that one takes a single day.

lines.zh: 游得多，肉才这么紧实。
lines.en: I swim so much that my flesh stays firm.

lines.zh: 水面下的影子动了，我追上去。
lines.en: A shadow moves below the surface; I chase it.

lines.zh: 深蓝的水里，我游得最快。
lines.en: In deep blue water, I am the fastest one around.

lines.zh: 我拐过一个洋流，尾巴还在摆。
lines.en: I round a current, tail still beating.

lines.zh: 上面有船影，我往下潜了两格。
lines.en: A hull shadow above; I sink a couple of blocks.

lines.zh: 我咬住一条沙丁鱼，没减速。
lines.en: I snap up a sardine without slowing.

lines.zh: 海面的光斜下来，我跟着它游。
lines.en: Light slants down through the surface; I follow it.

lines.zh: 我悬在蓝里，鳃一直开着。
lines.en: I hang in the blue with my gills wide open.

lines.zh: 游了这么远，我停一会。
lines.en: After such a long swim, I rest a moment.

lines.zh: 同伴在附近，我不必回头。
lines.en: My school is nearby, so I needn't look back.

lines.zh: 海水推着我的侧身，很轻。
lines.en: The sea pushes gently against my flank.

lines.zh: 我在听更远处的鱼群。
lines.en: I am listening for schools further off.

lines.zh: 这一片海，安静得不像远洋。
lines.en: This stretch is quieter than the open ocean should be.

lines.zh: 我的背是深蓝，藏在蓝里。
lines.en: My back is deep blue, hidden in the blue.

lines.zh: 肚子空着，我还能撑很久。
lines.en: My belly is empty, and I can last a long while.

lines.zh: 水面的光，我只需要一点点。
lines.en: I need only a little of the light from above.

lines.zh: 同伴一停，我也停。
lines.en: When my school stops, I stop too.

lines.zh: 这片海域的盐味，我熟悉。
lines.en: I know the salt taste of these waters.

lines.zh: 我在等一股新的暖流。
lines.en: I am waiting for a fresh warm current.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴比鳍更有力。
lines.en: My tail is stronger than any of my fins.

lines.zh: 我悬在水层里，只动鳃盖。
lines.en: I hang in the water, moving only my gill covers.

lines.zh: 你在船上看了我很久。
lines.en: You have watched me from the boat a while.

lines.zh: 我的背是深蓝的，看不清吧。
lines.en: My back is deep blue — hard to make out.

lines.zh: 一条竿一条线，就想钓我？
lines.en: One rod and one line, and you plan to land me?

lines.zh: 我贴着船底游过去。
lines.en: I swim right under your hull.

lines.zh: 你的影子投下来，我不怕。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on me; I am not afraid.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴比你的手臂有力。
lines.en: My tail is stronger than your arm.

lines.zh: 你数我们的数量，二到四条。
lines.en: You count us — two to four in this group.

lines.zh: 桶太小，装不下我。
lines.en: That bucket is too small to hold me.

lines.zh: 你看我，我就游慢一点。
lines.en: If you watch, I will slow down a little.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看船，又沉下去。
lines.en: I glance up at the boat, then sink away.

lines.zh: 我的鳞被撞掉了几片。
lines.en: A few of my scales have been knocked loose.

lines.zh: 被撞的地方，鳞片卷了起来。
lines.en: The hit makes my whole tail convulse.

lines.zh: 谁在水里偷袭我？
lines.en: Who ambushed me underwater?

lines.zh: 我加快摆尾，想甩开它。
lines.en: I beat my tail harder to shake it off.

lines.zh: 血顺着海流，拖出长长一条。
lines.en: My blood ribbons off behind me in the current.

lines.zh: 这一下，让我慢了半拍。
lines.en: My stroke is off by a half beat now.

lines.zh: 我的肉太紧实，伤得不深。
lines.en: My flesh is dense, so the wound isn't deep.

lines.zh: 同伴围了过来。
lines.en: My school has closed in around me.

lines.zh: 我还能游，只是不太快。
lines.en: I can still swim, just not very fast.

lines.zh: 远洋里，受伤就得一直动。
lines.en: In the open ocean, injured means keep moving.

lines.zh: 钩上那条小鱼，我看见了。
lines.en: I see that small fish on the hook.

lines.zh: 这味道，是刚出水的。
lines.en: This scent is fresh out of the water.

lines.zh: 我绕一圈，先试试水深。
lines.en: I make a lap and test the depth first.

lines.zh: 同伴都往那边游了。
lines.en: My school is heading that way.

lines.zh: 饥饿让我不再谨慎。
lines.en: Hunger has made me less careful.

lines.zh: 那点闪动，像受伤的鱼。
lines.en: That flicker looks like a wounded fish.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴冲过去。
lines.en: I rush in with my mouth open.

lines.zh: 诱饵越挣扎，我越想吃。
lines.en: The more the bait struggles, the more I want it.

lines.zh: 不吃饱，游不了远路。
lines.en: Without a full belly I can't travel far.

lines.zh: 这一次，我咬定了。
lines.en: This time I am taking it.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，鱼鳞都响了。
lines.en: We collide and our scales clatter.

lines.zh: 我游得太快，来不及拐弯。
lines.en: I was going too fast to turn.

lines.zh: 对不起，我跟着鱼群走神了。
lines.en: Sorry — I was following my school and lost focus.

lines.zh: 这一撞，把我撞偏了三格。
lines.en: That knock pushed me three blocks off course.

lines.zh: 水里太挤，大家都往这边。
lines.en: It's crowded down here; everyone heads this way.

lines.zh: 我的身子滑，撞了也不疼。
lines.en: My body is slippery; a bump doesn't hurt.

lines.zh: 别在水里站着不动。
lines.en: Don't just float there without moving.

lines.zh: 鱼群一乱，就互相撞。
lines.en: When the school panics, we bump into each other.

lines.zh: 我甩尾稳住身子。
lines.en: I flick my tail to steady myself.

lines.zh: 你也被撞得退了半步吧。
lines.en: You got knocked back half a step too, didn't you.

lines.zh: 同群的鱼，尾鳍节奏一样。
lines.en: In my school, all our tails beat the same rhythm.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，谁也不落下。
lines.en: We swim abreast, nobody falling behind.

lines.zh: 这片暖流，适合养小鱼。
lines.en: This warm current is good for raising young.

lines.zh: 你游得快，我追得上。
lines.en: You swim fast, and I can match you.

lines.zh: 一群二到四条，正好。
lines.en: Two to four to a group — that is just right.

lines.zh: 我们绕着彼此转半圈。
lines.en: We circle each other half a turn.

lines.zh: 跟上，别被海流冲散。
lines.en: Keep up; don't let the current split us.

lines.zh: 明年还在这片海产卵。
lines.en: Next year we spawn in this same sea.

lines.zh: 远洋虽大，同伴难得。
lines.en: The open sea is vast; good company is rare.

lines.zh: 一起游，路就没那么长。
lines.en: Swimming together makes the road shorter.

lines.zh: 掉下来的鱼，我一口咬住。
lines.en: A fish falls; I snap it up.

lines.zh: 沉底的东西，我顺路捡。
lines.en: Things on the bottom — I grab them in passing.

lines.zh: 我嘴里只能含一样。
lines.en: I can only hold one thing in my mouth.

lines.zh: 这块肉，够我游半天。
lines.en: This chunk of meat will fuel half a day's swim.

lines.zh: 水里漂着的，我都不浪费。
lines.en: Anything drifting by, I don't waste.

lines.zh: 咬住了，可它有点硬。
lines.en: I've got it, though it's a bit hard.

lines.zh: 带回去给同伴。
lines.en: I'll carry it back to my school.

lines.zh: 我叼着它，绕同伴游一圈。
lines.en: I carry it in my jaws around the school once.

lines.zh: 这味道不是鱼，但能吃。
lines.en: It doesn't smell like fish, but it's edible.

lines.zh: 先咬一口，再说别的。
lines.en: First a bite, then we'll talk.

lines.zh: 前面有鱼群，我正在冲。
lines.en: A school ahead — I am charging.

lines.zh: 那条鱼游得慢，我挑它。
lines.en: That fish swims slow; I pick it.

lines.zh: 血的味道，从左边来。
lines.en: The smell of blood comes from the left.

lines.zh: 水花一响，我知道有东西。
lines.en: A splash — I know something is there.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛已经锁定。
lines.en: My eyes have already found its wake.

lines.zh: 它想躲进水草，来不及了。
lines.en: It wants to hide in the weeds; too late.

lines.zh: 我加速，尾巴拍得更急。
lines.en: I speed up, tail beating faster.

lines.zh: 一大群，够吃很久。
lines.en: A big school — enough to last a while.

lines.zh: 那条最小的，最容易得手。
lines.en: The smallest one is the easiest catch.

lines.zh: 同伴散开，我从侧面绕。
lines.en: My school fans out; I come around the side.

lines.zh: 它还在追小鱼，没留意身后。
lines.en: It's still chasing small fish, blind to what's behind.

lines.zh: 十格，正好冲刺。
lines.en: Ten blocks — the perfect distance to sprint.

lines.zh: 我把身体绷紧，像一支箭。
lines.en: I draw myself taut like an arrow.

lines.zh: 它往深处沉，我跟下去。
lines.en: It sinks deeper; I follow.

lines.zh: 再等它拐弯的一瞬。
lines.en: Wait for the instant it turns.

lines.zh: 我的鳃里全是氧。
lines.en: My gills are full of oxygen.

lines.zh: 水面太亮，我从下面靠近。
lines.en: The surface is bright; I approach from below.

lines.zh: 它和同伴分开了。
lines.en: It has separated from its school.

lines.zh: 尾鳍一摆，就出发。
lines.en: One flick of the tail and I am off.

lines.zh: 从这个角度，它拐不出我的路线。
lines.en: From this angle, it can't cut across my path.

lines.zh: 我全速撞上去，水都炸开。
lines.en: I ram at full speed and the water bursts.

lines.zh: 牙咬进鳞里，甩也甩不掉。
lines.en: I close my jaws and hold through the thrash.

lines.zh: 它的侧腹被我顶穿。
lines.en: I have driven through its flank.

lines.zh: 我的力气全在尾根上。
lines.en: All my strength sits at the base of my tail.

lines.zh: 这一撞，比咬更疼。
lines.en: This ram hurts worse than a bite.

lines.zh: 它翻着白肚皮沉下去了。
lines.en: It rolls belly-up and sinks.

lines.zh: 我绕开血水，继续追。
lines.en: I swing clear of the blood and keep chasing.

lines.zh: 远洋的肉食者，就是我。
lines.en: Open-ocean predator — that is me.

lines.zh: 撞击之后，我喘了口气。
lines.en: After the hit I take one breath.

lines.zh: 别小看一条鱼的冲力。
lines.en: Don't underestimate a fish's charge.

lines.zh: 暖流把我带进这片海。
lines.en: The warm current brought me into this sea.

lines.zh: 我睁眼时，同伴已经在旁边。
lines.en: When I open my eyes, my school is already beside me.

lines.zh: 海面很远，光却很亮。
lines.en: The surface is far, but the light is bright.

lines.zh: 这一群二到四条，我是第三条。
lines.en: Two to four to a group — I am the third.

lines.zh: 海水从鳃里过，我活过来了。
lines.en: Seawater runs through my gills; I am alive.

lines.zh: 深蓝的地方，最适合起跑。
lines.en: Deep blue water is the best place to start.

lines.zh: 我一出现，附近的小鱼就散了。
lines.en: The moment I appear, nearby small fish scatter.

lines.zh: 这片海很普通，但够大。
lines.en: This sea is ordinary, but it is big enough.

lines.zh: 先摆两下尾，找找节奏。
lines.en: Two flicks of the tail, to find my rhythm.

lines.zh: 我要游到很远的地方去。
lines.en: I mean to swim somewhere very far away.

lines.zh: 水面上的火，把我的背烤焦了。
lines.en: Fire on the surface has scorched my back.

lines.zh: 我摔在甲板上，拼命拍尾。
lines.en: I land on the deck, thrashing my tail.

lines.zh: 离开了水，我的鳃吸不到气。
lines.en: Out of the water, my gills can't draw breath.

lines.zh: 炸浪把我甩出海面。
lines.en: The blast throws me clear out of the sea.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西钉进了我的背。
lines.en: A barb sits deep between my back scales.

lines.zh: 紫雾钻进鳃里，我乱了方向。
lines.en: Violet mist seeps into my gills; I lose direction.

lines.zh: 游了这么远，肚子却空着。
lines.en: I have swum so far on an empty belly.

lines.zh: 雷落进海里，我的鳞全竖了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the sea and every scale stands up.

lines.zh: 下方没有海，我的尾无处可摆。
lines.en: No sea below; my tail has nothing to push against.
